'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matthew Harrison-Trainor LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Blay
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
